ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.

2. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. run
   C. happiness
   D. quickly

3. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language School.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.

4. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.

5. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.

6. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only an action
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

7. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.

8. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

9. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. Where is the library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

10. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.

11. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.

12. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Language Welcome and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Language School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
